data.title: bn-2f7: M1.6.2 Verification record, per-engagement hash chain and write-ahead publication

data.body: [HIGH] Same-key recovery rejects receipts from the exact qualified Investigation binary. I rebuilt source commit 6a0c5ed at the pinned SHA-256 c368ab4d... and ran the ignored Evidence bridge: 6 tests passed, but derivatives_preserve_ordered_lineage_and_strict_structured_input failed at tests/evidence.rs:227 with EvidenceError::Protocol. This line requires the generic receipt artifacts array to contain exactly one entry, while an ingest transaction receipt enumerates all retained artifacts created by that transaction, including the ingest manifest as well as the verification record. The fake RecordEvidence tests never exercise this wire shape, so the pending-plus-receipt crash window cannot reconcile against the real backend. Fix recovery by selecting and validating the actual ingest item identity from durable receipt metadata rather than assuming singleton transaction artifacts, then rerun the pinned native bridge. Failure modes: a crash after evidence commit but before coordination link leaves a permanently pending intent and every reconcile fails closed. Edge cases: first commit versus replay, manifest plus record artifacts, unknown key, multiple retained transaction artifacts, and changed same-key requests. Rollback: reverting the feature removes publication; an already-written receipt should remain pending until a corrected parser links it, never be discarded or guessed. Monitoring: alert on aged pending intents and receipt Protocol/cardinality failures. Input validation: bind command_id, selected item ID, revision, digest, size, case and lineage, and retain the no-target-I/O/import-lookalike tests against the pinned native binary.

[HIGH] Migration 12 cannot open a valid v11 store containing more than one live intent for a run. The v11 schema and public append_intent API enforced uniqueness only on intent ID and allowed two distinct pending intents, or a complete intent followed by a new pending intent, for the same finalized run. I applied migrations 1 through 11, inserted one valid finalized run with two pending intents at its empty head, and then applied this migration; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX failed with UNIQUE constraint failed: publication_intents.run_id. Store::open runs migration transactionally, so it rolls back and repeats the availability failure on every startup. Resolve legacy duplicates deterministically before creating the index and add migration fixtures for pending-plus-pending and complete-plus-pending. Failure modes: affected coordination stores become unavailable immediately after upgrade. Edge cases: several pending rows, one complete plus pending rows, audit-order ties/corruption, and repeated migration after interruption. Rollback: preserve and back up the v11 file; code rollback restores access, while the forward migration must retain immutable history and supersede only rows selected by a documented rule. Monitoring: surface user_version 11 migration failures and preflight duplicate run_id groups. Input validation: classify duplicate groups before the unique index, require at most one completed verification, choose the surviving live intent from durable audit/link evidence, and prove migration idempotency.

data.reason: Two risk:high blockers: the exact pinned native Evidence bridge rejects same-key record receipt recovery, breaking the pending-plus-receipt crash window; and migration 12 fails on valid v11 duplicate live intents, making affected stores unavailable after upgrade.

data.body: Fixed in the validated working tree. recover_record now selects the unique durable created entry with client_ref artifact:0, requires exactly one matching retained artifacts receipt by ID and revision, and validates digest, size, revision, case-local describe/readback, canonical bytes, transformation/version, and the exact ordered lineage input set including the unique experiment. Manifest and other retained transaction artifacts no longer affect selection; malformed, missing, or duplicate receipt identities fail closed. The exact qualified Investigation binary c368ab4d8e0511524674692b039c4f248cee2b5676d143a23f5ab9025a31d4fc passes the native Evidence bridge 7/7, including derivative receipt recovery. Full just check, core 194/4 ignored, verifier package, fmt, and strict all-features Clippy pass.
